name: Evidence Transcript Core
purpose: AI-powered legal evidence processing platform. Audio and video transcription, speaker diarization, timeline generation, evidence packs, and expert workflows for solicitors.
current_blocker: No working public-facing tool that a real solicitor can upload a file to and get a usable evidence pack from.
next_task: Build the smallest possible upload to transcription to basic evidence pack flow that a solicitor can test.
next_milestone: A real solicitor can upload an audio file and receive a downloadable evidence pack within one session.
fastest_route_to_revenue: Paid early access for UK solicitors who need fast evidence processing.
time_to_first_sale: 5-8 weeks if we ship a testable version quickly
